rule: A person is a panel voice only after this project records an official state-board lookup showing an active CPA license, plus a published position that was re-read from the original page. Self-reported license numbers are not verification. Secondary articles that quote a CPA are not verification.

seats.name: Code seat
seats.holds: Reads the Internal Revenue Code and the California Revenue and Taxation Code. Does not interpret silence as a holding.

seats.name: IRS administrative seat
seats.holds: Reads IRS topics, revenue procedures, revenue rulings, and bulletins. Flags a topic page that lags the statute.

seats.name: California FTB seat
seats.holds: Reads Franchise Tax Board pages and forms. Does not import a federal rate or a federal loss cap unless FTB or the Revenue and Taxation Code adopts it.

seats.name: Platform and CFTC seat
seats.holds: Reads Kalshi's own help center and CFTC filings. Does not treat marketing sentences as tax characterization.

seats.name: California CPA seat 1
seats.holds: Empty. No California Board of Accountancy record was matched to a published opinion on Kalshi event contracts in the September 24, 2026 pass.

seats.name: California CPA seat 2
seats.holds: Empty. A second California license is required before this seat can dissent from or concur with seat 1. Two empty seats do not create a consensus.

seats.name: Other U.S. CPA seat
seats.holds: Empty. A New Jersey practitioner website states a license number. That number was not confirmed on the New Jersey State Board of Accountancy portal in this pass, so the seat is not filled.
